source: Habibi-TTS Specialized/IRQ vocab.txt as mounted on the vewbox_models volume (tts/habibi/Specialized/IRQ/vocab.txt), read 2026-10-04 without starting a container
note: The single-character entries that Arabic or English dialogue could contain (Arabic blocks, Latin, digits, punctuation, symbols); CJK, Hangul, Cyrillic, Greek and the multi-character pinyin entries are left out. F5-TTS maps a character outside the vocab to index 0 (the space), so a line is spoken with such a character cut out of its word.
